decisions.reason: Adding refrigerators and revising marked walls or corridor space does not change the requirement to annotate room dimensions.

The furnished-plan refrigerator addition does not alter the base floor-plan deliverable or its required content, and removing particular marked walls does not eliminate the general requirement to depict separation walls.
The source does not identify Unit 2 bathroom placement, toilet drainage, or bathroom-door positioning.
The source does not change the Unit 3 bathroom requirement or its toilet-drain alignment; the separate drainage question appears only in message 44.
Refrigerator depiction and a localized request to leave space beside a counter do not necessarily change the three-dwelling open-plan cabinetry configuration or specified cabinet lengths.
The source does not discuss the Unit 1 common bathroom, toilet location, or drain alignment.

The instruction to remove purple-marked walls and leave the side of the counter empty may revise this counter layout, but the text does not identify Unit 3 and the referenced color-marked drawing is unavailable, so the target cannot be resolved safely.
The source does not change retention or shared use of the existing main entrance.
